limitations: recall reads exactly one aggregate (scope, scope_id). Cross-scope reads require an explicit separate call; there is no multi-scope pool and no API that merges scopes.
The Obsidian projection directory is scoped per service/store. rebuild() with tenant_id=None clears and rewrites the whole root; do not share one projection root across independent stores.
OpenViking is an injected adapter seam verified with the hermetic InMemoryOpenViking double. No live OpenViking server or network path was contacted or verified.
eventlog.append_event resolves an outbox-owning business, so a tenant must have at least one business before a memory event can be appended (P1-02 contract).
A supersession link to a tombstoned record is cleared in the projection (frontmatter supersedes=null) so no note links to a missing note; the authoritative event log still records the supersedes id.

Poisoning admission uses deterministic confidence/instruction-pattern rules, not a classifier. Untrusted content can be admitted explicitly with allow_untrusted/policy_allows, a trusted label, or a provenance policy marker.
